n = int(input())
b = int(input())
data = [int(input()) for _ in range(n)]

count = 0
sum_diff = 0
oddCount = 0
evenCount = 0
diffList = []

for i in range(n):
    if data[i] % 2 != 0:
        oddCount += 1
    else:
        evenCount += 1
    if i != n - 1 and oddCount == evenCount:
        diffList.append(abs(data[i + 1] - data[i]))

diffList.sort()

for diff in diffList:
    sum_diff += diff
    if sum_diff <= b:
        count += 1
    else:
        break

print(count)
